dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Layla is at risk due to behavioral reasons. While in care, Layla has been observed to be highly fearful. Noted to growl at handlers when they approach and retreat to the back of the kennel with a tense body and dodge the leash. Recently Layla allowed contact from a familiar handler on her head and back. Medically, Layla has CIRDC.

Layla arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. While Layla has been observed to be highly fearful. Noted to retreat to the back of the kennel with a tense body and dodge the leash. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only home.
